The Prop Kit · Photo Standard

The tableware kit — pick one

Your rule: everything that appears — glasses, cups, jars, all of it — standardised to 3–4 styles. Consistent, with enough variety. Every photo in the pass will draw only from this kit.

Fixed in every kit
The plate — LOCKEDYour scalloped “flowery” plate; every plate & bowl.
The jar — fixedYour 1.6 L clip-top Kilner; every ferment & store.
The cookware — lockedCream & sage enamelled cast iron; every pot & pan.
The one choice — cups & glasses
Option 1
All porcelain

Cups and saucers from the same fluted scalloped family as the plates; drinks in a plain clear glass. The purest, quietest kit.

Option 2
The bistro glass

Plates and cups in the fluted porcelain; drinks in a vintage French bistro fluted glass — the fluting on the glass echoes the fluting on the rims.

Option 3
Sage stoneware

Fluted porcelain for plates and bowls; cups and tumblers in matte sage stoneware that ties back to the cast iron. The warmest, most rustic kit.

Your call

Reply kit 1, 2 or 3. The winner becomes law: its tableware line joins the locked photo prompt, and every photo across all 49 cards draws only from the kit — plate family · your cup/glass pick · the Kilner · the cast iron.
